title: Stakeholder
description: TOGAF-sourced structural archetype — a person, team, or organization with interests in or concerns relative to architecture outcomes. An active system: the stakeholder performs governance functions (Mechanisms), produces decisions/approvals (Effectors), receives architecture deliverables (Receptors). Note: Actor and Stakeholder may represent the same real-world entity from different perspectives — Actor focuses on what they DO, Stakeholder on what they CARE ABOUT. Extends Structure with TOGAF Stakeholder Management vocabulary. TOGAF mapping: Stakeholder (Stakeholder Management, Architecture Governance, Content Metamodel). Source framework: TOGAF (Stakeholder Management, Architecture Governance).

role.description: Stakeholder role identifier (e.g., 'Enterprise Architect', 'CTO', 'Product Owner', 'Security Officer'). TOGAF mapping: Stakeholder role in the Stakeholder Map matrix.

influenceLevel.description: Level of influence on architecture decisions. KEY_DECISION_MAKER = has approval authority. INFLUENCER = shapes decisions but does not approve. INFORMED = receives decisions. TOGAF mapping: Stakeholder Power/Interest grid classification.

organizationUnit.description: Organizational unit to which the stakeholder belongs. TOGAF mapping: Organization Unit entity in Content Metamodel.
